content.title: Binance: The World’s Most Trusted Cryptocurrency Exchange to Buy, Trade & Invest in Crypto
content.text: Frequently Asked Questions1Why is Binance the Best Exchange for Crypto Traders in India?Binance is the best cryptocurrency exchange for traders in India and globally because it offers deep liquidity, low fees, and a complete range of products including Spot, Futures, Earn, and P2P markets. It allows users to track crypto live prices, explore new cryptocurrencies, and discover top gaining cryptos or top losing cryptocurrencies. Binance also provides early access to crypto projects via Binance Alpha. With strong security, global liquidity, and an easy-to-use interface, Binance remains the trusted choice for millions of crypto traders worldwide. Additionally, Binance’s SAFU (Secure Asset Fund for Users) holds a reserve of 1 billion USDC (as of September 2025), serving as an emergency fund designed to protect users' assets.2How can I buy Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies in India?There are several ways to buy cryptocurrencies on Binance. You can use a credit/debit card to purchase crypto on Binance. Before getting started, please make sure you’ve completed Identity Verification for your Binance account.3How do I buy USDT via P2P?To buy USDT safely on Binance P2P, start by completing your KYC verification. Then head to the P2P section, select USDT, and filter by your local currency along with your preferred payment method. Choose a seller with a high completion rate, positive reviews, and a strong trade history. After placing your order, send the payment directly to the seller using the shown payment details. Once you’ve made the transfer, tap “Transferred, Notify Seller”. Your USDT will be released from Binance’s escrow and added to your funding wallet.4How to trade cryptocurrencies in India on Binance?You can trade hundreds of cryptocurrencies on Binance via the Spot, Margin, Futures, and Options markets. To begin trading, users need to register an account, complete identity verification, buy/deposit crypto, and start trading.5What products does Binance offer for crypto users?Binance is the world's leading cryptocurrency exchange, catering to over 300 million registered users in over 180 countries. With low fees and over 600 cryptocurrencies to trade, Binance is the preferred exchange to trade Bitcoin, Altcoins, and other virtual assets. With Binance, users can: Trade hundreds of cryptocurrencies on Spot, Margin, and Futures markets. Buy and sell cryptocurrencies with Binance P2P. Earn interest on your crypto with Binance Earn. Buy or earn new tokens on Binance Alpha, Airdrop, etc. To get started, check out our learning.6How to earn passive income from crypto on Binance?Users can earn rewards on more than 180+ cryptocurrencies by using one of the products offered on Binance Earn. Our platform offers dozens of digital assets like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins.7How to trade safely on Binance P2P?While buying crypto on Binance P2P, always trade with verified buyers or sellers who have high completion rates, and ensure all communication and payments stay strictly within the Binance P2P platform. Double-check payment details, use only your preferred methods, and rely on Binance’s escrow for protection. Read 4 Common P2P Crypto Trading Mistakes to Avoid to stay safe.8How to track cryptocurrency prices?The easiest way to track the latest cryptocurrency prices, trading volumes, trending altcoins, and market cap is the Binance Cryptocurrency Directory. Click on the coins to know historical coin prices, 24-hour trading volume, and the price of cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin, Ethereum, BNB and others in real-time.9How do I avoid scams and keep my Binance account secure in India?To keep your crypto safe on Binance, always enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA), avoid sharing passwords or codes, and never click on suspicious links. To know how to protect your crypto, read our Tips to Keep Your Binance Account Secure.
